title: EEG Foundation Models Need Channel Adaptation, but Fixed Channel Mappings Often Suffice
abstract: arXiv:2604.23091v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scaling EEG foundation models requires pooling data across heterogeneous montages, so every model needs a channel-adaptation step mapping an arbitrary source montage onto its expected input. Whether this step must be learned, and whether it confounds cross-model comparison, is untested. We compare five channel-adaptation routes (a learned Conv1d projection, spherical spline interpolation, source-space decomposition, Riemannian re-centering, and each model's native handling) across five pretrained models (5M--157M parameters), five downstream tasks, two training regimes, and up to 15 random seeds. The answer is architecture-dependent rather than adapter-universal: fixed or native mappings are best in 18 of 25 model--task cells, but regime-specific wins are distributed across Native/Conv1d/SSI/OmnEEG/Riemannian. Rigid fixed-input BENDR is the main case where a learned bridge is needed; the strongest model, CBraMod, reaches its best res

translated_title: EEG基础模型需要通道适配，但固定的通道映射往往已经足够
translated_abstract: 扩展EEG基础模型需要汇集来自不同异构电极配置的数据，因此每个模型都需要一个通道适配步骤，将任意的源电极配置映射到其预期的输入格式上。然而，这一步骤是否必须通过学习获得，以及它是否会混淆跨模型的比较，此前尚未得到检验。我们在五个预训练模型（500万至1.57亿参数）、五个下游任务、两种训练模式以及多达15个随机种子上，比较了五种通道适配方法（可学习的Conv1d投影、球面样条插值、源空间分解、黎曼重定中心，以及各模型的原生处理方式）。结论是结果取决于架构，而非存在普适的适配器：在25个模型-任务组合中，有18个组合里固定或原生映射表现最佳，但特定训练模式下的优势分布在原生方法、Conv1d、球面样条插值（SSI）、OmnEEG和黎曼方法之间。采用刚性固定输入的BENDR是唯一主要需要学习式桥接的案例；表现最强的模型CBraMod则达到了其最佳结果……
tldr: 该研究通过对五个EEG预训练模型的系统评测发现，通道适配方法的选择取决于具体架构而非普适规律——在大多数模型-任务组合中简单的固定通道映射就已足够，只有刚性固定输入的BENDR等少数模型才需要可学习的适配方法。
en_tdlr: A systematic evaluation of five pretrained EEG foundation models shows that the need for channel adaptation is architecture-dependent—fixed channel mappings suffice in 18 of 25 model-task pairs, with learned adaptation mainly required for rigid fixed-input models like BENDR.
